SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT W.*, C.METHODNAME, C.TESTMETHODBASIS, C.METHODNO, C.SOURCE, D.TESTCATEGORYDESC AS TESTCATEGORY, E.ORGNAME, F.TESTNAME, G.BEFOREHANDLENAME FROM T_EMC_TEST_METHOD W LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD C ON W.METHODID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_CATEGORY D ON W.TESTCATEGORYID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG E ON W.ANALYSISORGID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST F ON W.TESTID = F.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TESTMETHOD_BEFOREHANDLE G ON W.BEFOREHANDLEID = G.ID) T
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${targetTable} TAR_ WHERE TAR_.${targetTestMethodIdColumn} = T.ID
AND TAR_.${targetFilterColumn} = #{targetFilterValue}
AND TAR_.${targetFilterColumn1} = #{targetFilterValue1}
)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_CERT_TEST_METHOD TAR_ WHERE TAR_.TESTID = T.TESTID AND TAR_.METHODID = T.METHODID AND TAR_.CERTID = #{targetFilterValue1} )
AND ID IN(${tmids})
AND ID NOT IN(${tmidsnotin})
AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_MONITOR_SCHEME MS WHERE MS.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId} AND MS.TESTMETHODID = T.ID )
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.*, C.METHODNAME, C.TESTMETHODBASIS, D.TESTCATEGORYDESC AS TESTCATEGORY, E.ORGNAME, F.TESTNAME FROM T_EMC_TEST_METHOD T LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD C ON T.METHODID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_CATEGORY D ON T.TESTCATEGORYID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG E ON T.ANALYSISORGID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST F ON T.TESTID = F.ID WHERE T.ID = #{id}
